title: Design of Fe3S4@Lip Composite for pH-Selective and Magnetically Targeted Programmed Release of H2S
content: The significance of hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) in vivo is multifaceted, functioning as a crucial gaseous signaling molecule with extensive physiological and pathological impacts within organisms. To create novel H₂S-releasing materials, we synthesized Fe₃S₄@Lip, a gas slow-release bioreactor, which exhibits stable and sustained H₂S release properties. Our gas releaser possesses selective H₂S release capabilities, and notably, it can achieve effective H₂S release under magnetic force with the assistance of a magnetic field. In conclusion, our findings suggest that Fe₃S₄@Lip can function as an H₂S slow-release bioreactor, offering a potentially innovative approach for programmed H₂S release in vivo.
